pattern: SVG radar chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "radar chart") of role="img" vertices with two-dimensional roving focus (around the axes, between series); legend of toggle buttons; data table fallback with one row per axis.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription "radar chart" (localized), named by the title
img with an aria-label: axis, series, formatted value
list (ul) named "Legend"; entries are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
table (native) with caption, column headers (Axis, then each series), and row headers (axes); wide tables scroll in a focusable region

roles.element: rings, spokes, tick labels, axis names, polygons, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
Localized "{axis}, {series}: {value}", for example "Power, Beta: 2"; missing values read "No value"
0 on exactly one vertex (roving); other vertices have none
true while the series is visible
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Next (clockwise) / previous axis of the same series; swapped in RTL so forward follows the reading direction.
Same axis in the next / previous visible series (single visible series: next / previous axis).
First (top) / last axis of the series.
Ten axes back / forward (clamped to the ends).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Legend buttons, then one tab stop for the plot (the active vertex), then the Show data table button and table region.
Shows or hides the series (native button).

focus: Roving focus: one vertex is in the tab sequence and remembers the last visited vertex, also across re-renders (resize, update, series toggles). Toggling a legend entry keeps focus on its button; toggling the table keeps focus on the table button.
notes: The generated summary lists the type, series and axis counts, the axis names in order, the scale, each series' highest and lowest axis, and hidden series, for example "radar chart, 2 series, 4 axes: Speed, Power, Range, and Armor. Scale {from} to {to}. Alpha: highest 5 on Power, lowest 2 on Range. ..."
Meaning never depends on color alone: series differ by marker shape and (with patterns) dash pattern, and the legend keys repeat them.
Axes keep clockwise order in RTL (a radar has no reading axis, like pie charts); only ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are swapped.
Missing values are drawn at the center and read "No value".
Forced colors: series use CanvasText and keep shapes and dashes; axis names use CanvasText; focus uses Highlight.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
Polygon area depends on axis order and exaggerates differences; the summary and table give exact values.
